text: DSH Config Origin Proof 为 DSH 插件、命令行工具和 MCP 服务提供配置来源核验。DSH 工具读取显式的脱敏来源记录，检查各配置优先级域的胜出来源、值摘要、被遮蔽来源及未观察的高优先级来源；命令行可将核验结果写成内容寻址报告，MCP 接口则处理内联记录。适合需要复核配置来源和优先级判断的 DSH 维护者。使用时提供记录文件或内联 JSON；插件没有配置项或 API 密钥要求。

DSH Config Origin Proof checks redacted configuration records through DSH tools, CLI, and MCP. It verifies precedence winners and value digests, reporting shadowed or unobserved sources. The CLI writes a content-addressed report from a recording file; no API key or plugin setting is required.
想核对一项 DSH 配置最终由哪个来源提供。
帮我验证配置来源优先级、胜出项和被覆盖项是否符合预期。
I need a reproducible report showing which recorded configuration source won and why.
DSH Config Origin Proof 的功能「配置来源核验」：读取显式的脱敏记录，按配置域优先级核对预期胜出来源和值摘要，并列出被遮蔽来源及未观察的高优先级来源；通过 DSH 工具或 CLI 提交记录。
dsh-config-origin-proof 提供工具 dsh_config_origin_inspect：Inspect an explicit value-redacted configuration-origin recording.
dsh-config-origin-proof 提供工具 dsh_config_origin_verify：Verify precedence winners, value digests, shadowed sources and observation gaps; write one content-addressed report.

dsh-config-origin-proof README · DSH Config Origin Proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

An evidence layer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) configuration source ownership. It verifies an explicit redacted recording of precedence domains, source observations, the expected winning source and value digest, shadowed sources, and unobserved higher-priority gaps.

dsh-config-origin-proof README · DSH Config Origin Proof：It does **not** reimplement the DSH composer, collect live configuration, or compare policy changes. DSH's own `--dump-config` remains the authority for composition. This plugin turns a structured recording from that or another trusted producer into a reproducible receipt. `dsh-policy-drift-proof` compares baseline and observed policy posture; `dsh-profile-lock-proof` proves installed bundle closure; this project answers which recorded source won and why.

dsh-config-origin-proof README · DSH Config Origin Proof：Raw values and secret-, credential-, prompt-, message- or prose-shaped fields are rejected. Reports contain only stable IDs, SHA-256 digests and verdicts. The verifier fails closed when a higher-priority source is unobserved.

dsh-config-origin-proof README · Surfaces：- DSH: `dsh_config_origin_inspect`, `dsh_config_origin_verify`.
- CLI: `dsh-config-origin-proof verify --workspace-root examples --recording recording.json --artifact-dir artifacts`.
- MCP: `config_origin_inspect_inline`, `config_origin_verify_inline`; inline-only, no filesystem, network, process or artifact writes.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dongsheng123132/dsh-config-origin-proof
npm test
npm run check
npm run smoke:plugin

dsh-config-origin-proof README · Surfaces：The ordering in `examples/recording.json` follows DSH's published configuration-source ownership contract, but the recording is explicit and revision-bound so a future DSH change cannot silently rewrite old evidence.

dsh-config-origin-proof README · DSH Config Origin Proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

面向 DeepSeek Harness 配置来源归属的证据层：验证一份显式、脱敏的来源记录，给出优先级域、各层观察、实际胜出来源、被遮蔽来源和值摘要，并在高优先级来源未观察时失败闭合。

它不重做 DSH 配置组合器、不采集现场配置，也不替代策略漂移或安装闭包证明。DSH 自带的 `--dump-config` 仍是组合权威；本插件只把可信生产者形成的结构化记录变成可复核收据。`dsh-policy-drift-proof` 回答前后策略是否变化，`dsh-profile-lock-proof` 回答安装闭包是否固定，本项目回答记录中的配置由哪一层赢得以及为什么。

dsh-config-origin-proof README · DSH Config Origin Proof：拒绝原始值、秘密、凭据、prompt、消息和正文形字段；报告只含稳定 ID、SHA-256 与判决。DSH/CLI 只读取 workspace 内显式文件并向显式 `artifactDir` 写内容寻址报告；MCP 只处理有界内联 JSON，不读写文件、不联网、不启动子进程。

DSH 工具：`dsh_config_origin_inspect`、`dsh_config_origin_verify`。MIT。
